queue.topic: Title, possession and ownership disputes: verifying title before purchase, adverse possession (Ravinder Kaur Grewal and later rulings), cancellation of registered sale deeds under Section 31 Specific Relief Act, co-owner disputes and partition, limitation.

Cheque dishonour under Section 138 NI Act: notice and limitation, presumptions, interim compensation under Section 143A, appeals and Section 148, company directors under Section 141, parallel civil recovery and recent Supreme Court directions.

NRI matrimonial disputes: divorce jurisdiction when spouses live in different countries, look-out circulars, cross-border child custody and the Hague Convention position (India is not a party; Supreme Court approach), maintenance and enforcement of foreign orders; informational only.

NRI taxation basics: residential status under the Income-tax Act 2025 (in force from 1 April 2026), DTAA relief and tax residency certificate, TDS on property sale by NRI and lower deduction certificate, repatriation limits under FEMA; confirm each against official sources.

Conducting Indian litigation from abroad: appearance through attorney and power of attorney, video conferencing and remote evidence, service of summons abroad and apostille or attestation of documents, limitation and costs of absence; informational only.

NRI homebuyers and RERA: remedies for delayed possession, refund and interest, filing a complaint from abroad, authority powers, consumer forum alternative, resale and FEMA rules for NRI property purchases.

Cross-border judgments and money recovery: enforcing Indian decrees abroad and foreign judgments in India under Sections 13, 14 and 44A CPC, reciprocating territories, arbitration awards link, limitation, and practical evidence requirements.
